## Problem

Which repetitive or risky real-world workflow should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the expected result, ideally in terms of **Discover → Plan → Confirm → Execute → Verify**.

## Affected components

Local UI / backend / SSH agent / 3x-ui / Caddy / Docker / UFW / Xray / subscriptions / other

## Safety requirements

Who owns the target resource? Could the operation interrupt VPN clients or modify a shared service? What needs a backup, explicit confirmation or rollback?

## Alternatives

Any manual workaround or simpler approach worth considering?

Use synthetic example addresses and data. Do not post credentials or live VPS details.
